title: Rabbi Chana bar Livai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Sanhedrin 108b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.108b.21). Hyman reports the reading Rabbi Chanina in Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin.

notes.text: The [ark narrative](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.108b.19) on the same folio names Rav Chana bar Bizna. In that story Eliezer questions Shem about the ark. The later passage naming Rav Chana bar Livai gives the exchange about Abraham’s war with the kings, where Shem questions Eliezer.

[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1385&lang=en) cites the Sanhedrin passage and says Yuchasin lists Chanina bar Livai, whom he did not find. The exact Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin editions Hyman cites have not been checked here.
